groups.algorithm: Bit-preserving gather by integer index with host and device bounds checks.
alternatives: Simplified last-axis address formula preserves exact ownership and generic fallback.
Grouping neighbouring outputs into a DMA/vector gather tile may amortize input accesses but must preserve bitwise payloads and irregular indices; requires measured locality.
groups.ownership: Disjoint output ownership; no cross-core writes to another task output.
groups.synchronization: Per-core input/compute/output dependencies; no cross-core synchronization.
groups.task_partition: One output element has one owning core in disjoint intervals; index/input arrays are read-only.
groups.workspace_formula: 0 global intermediate; any new cross-core reduction or carry pass requires revised plan.
